transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mina. Rafael, I understand you're interested in a maintenance exchange for your cargo e-bike. Before I can make any decision, I'll need you to state your complete proposed exchange and appointment details out loud, and we'll need the person who inspected the bike to state their technical findings out loud as well. I'll be recording both statements before I decide on the terms. So — who's ready to start?
